verdict.rationale: x402 is an HTTP payment protocol whose documented public APIs can be driven programmatically. The CDP Facilitator verifies and settles payments for resource servers, and the public Bazaar discovery APIs come with a generated OpenAPI client and an MCP server. Runtime probes confirm the keyless discovery endpoint returns live listings and the facilitator auth-gates exactly as documented. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec found at standard docs paths, and the pack lacks endpoint-level reference detail for the facilitator verify/settle API.
